additional_info.subject: ID0372051-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117072] IMD_BC2 CRM:00643000841
additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R6 313065117072
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
XK771I
Problem Description
: IMD_BC2 error
Troubleshooting
: We're seeing the charger on SCB and the IMD error on BC2 is shown below.
MB-Er:1 IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:0 Capa:0 RlyConn:0 Init:0 SIS:0
MB-Er:
1: if no new data from IMD recieved within 5s via Modbus
RlyConn:
0: connection of the relays for signalling isowarning/ -failure is not tested
Init:
0: not initialized
SIS standby isolation status:
0: value not valid (modbus values != relay values)
To troubleshoot the IMD_BC2 error, please perform the following steps:
Check the power supply to the IMD_BC2 to ensure it is receiving 24VDC.
Verify the wiring connections between the measuring unit and the display unit.
Inspect the wiring connections to KF4, where the BC2 connections are routed.
Check the wiring connections of KF11 that lead into the IMD.
Look for any loose connections at the XD10 and XD42 terminals.
Arrange for a spare IMD in case there is an internal error. If not needed, the spare IMD can be used in another project in the future.
Please let me know if you have any further questions. If not, we can proceed with handing this case over to your queue for troubleshooting during the intervention.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0372051
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
